info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Prehnitc Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Prehnitc Syrup Catalog Management API allows for the seamless introduction of detailed information regarding Prehnitc Syrup into the product catalog. This API facilitates the registration of new syrup products, complete with specifications and attributes essential for business operations. Typical consumers include product managers, inventory systems, and e-commerce platforms aiming to maintain up-to-date product listings. Users can leverage this API to enhance their product offerings and ensure accurate representation in the market.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details for the prehnitc syrup, including specifications, uses, and additional information necessary for proper utilization and understanding of the product.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create a new entry for Prehnitc syrup. The information must comply with the required schema to ensure that all necessary fields are provided and formatted correctly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

prehnitc_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Prehnitc Syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Prehnitc Syrup requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of Prehnitc Syrup.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the packaging for the Prehnitc Syrup.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of codes corresponding to the warehouses where the Prehnitc Syrup is stored.
